qa: Yes, you can suspend either player's Digimon.

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: When this card would be played, by suspending 2 Digimon, reduce the play cost by 4. ＜Alliance＞ ＜Vortex＞ [When Digivolving] You may suspend 1 Digimon. Then, you may delete 1 of your opponent's 8000 DP or lower Digimon. For each other suspended Digimon, add 3000 to this DP deletion effect's maximum. [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When Digimon are played, you may activate 1 of this Digimon's [When Digivolving] effects.
